Axiom: Every workflow consumer resolves each affected file with `npx gennady orient --file --json` before classification. The versioned result separates one `semantic-owner` (`@spec`) from `planned`, `active`, `blocked`, and `history` ticket relations. Continue or recover a ticket only from one unambiguous `active` relation and only when its state policy permits it. `history` explains prior work but never authorizes automatic reopen. When no active relation exists, route through the resolved semantic-owner spec to select, create, or recover maintenance work; `planned`, `blocked`, and `history` may inform that selection but are never direct routing authority. Unresolved/ambiguous ownership fails closed. Legacy `@tasks` is migration evidence only and never routing authority for V2.
